## Fixed

- Keep AX event updates responsive when another application's periodic window read is blocked. Revalidate queued process identities and cancel stale reads after shutdown or process replacement.
- Preserve successful window titles exactly as supplied by Accessibility, including surrounding whitespace.
- Keep ordinary document windows visible when their title matches Notification Center; retain system-owner exclusions.
- Disable network access during code-signature validation for embedded-helper ownership.

## Maintenance

- Separate queued periodic AX reads from running reads and remove unused internal parameters.
- Resume interrupted release publication safely using the verified CI artifact and matching draft, tag and asset checks.

## Verification

Source CI passed 1014 unit tests, 246 constrained-executor tests, 13 Python tests, 31 Node.js tests and 3 WindowLab replay checks, plus arm64 Release packaging and deployment compatibility checks.

Source CI: https://github.com/sashokey/properwm/actions/runs/43126417792 . The release workflow reruns tests and package verification for this version before publication.
